cohort: Women who underwent either ECD or VAD at the second stage of labor between 30 0/7 and 33 6/7 weeks gestation, during 2011-2019.
finding: Cesarean delivery during the second stage of labor of gestations <34 weeks was associated with a higher rate of lower Apgar scores and longer length of stay.
mod_finding: Delivery by second stage CD of premature neonates <34 weeks is associated with a higher rate of lower Apgar score.
birth_weight: Median birth weight at delivery was 1845 g
